text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That comes to an even seven! The question is, of what?!
choice_data_list: The number of watermelons you split at camp.
The number of cicada shells you collected at camp.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The answer is the number of fancy-schmancy brooches in McQueen's collection!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That has nothing to do with summer camp, though!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You know the drill! As punishment for answering incorrectly, you have to walk back to the academy! Bye!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I make a beeline for the bus before it gets a chance to leave me behind.
